About the Center

Carnegie Europe draws on pan-European scholarship to deliver interdisciplinary expertise and independent insights, bringing together national, regional, and global perspectives and helping policymakers grasp and respond to today’s toughest challenges. From Brussels and other European capitals, we focus on three themes: European democracy and EU governance; political and international dynamics in wider Europe; and Europe’s efforts to meet today’s most pressing global challenges, from climate change to the new frontiers of artificial intelligence.
